answers.core: Every game having hitches in it isn't really a good look for Godot, and fixing that should be the default behavior.
answers.workaround: I imagine any larger project is going to want to use this.  It *can* be worked around, but it's more than a few lines of script, requires a lot of data setup, and it's very difficult to determine why shaders are being built.  I had to actually hack the engine to output what shaders were being compiled, and even with that, it was a challenge, because all the comments, blank lines, etc. are removed from the godot shader before being passed in there.

title: Add a way to precompile specific shader permutations and identify shaders compiled during gameplay
